answer: Each challenge is derived from a domain-separated hash of its task commitment and a future drand quicknet round, whose threshold-BLS pulse is unpredictable before publication and publicly verifiable afterward. A swarm therefore cannot precompute valid answers or farm a reusable offline cache: it must perform fresh work after each pulse. Per-identity limits and commit-reveal checks constrain parallel Sybils; garden, ridge, and vine are task inputs, not secrets.
